title: Tech Note: Programmable and Portable Component Subforms
author: Bertrand Soubeyrand, Consultants
featured_technology: OBJECT Get pointer / OBJECT Get name

historical_commentary.text: The subform communication mechanisms described here (CALL SUBFORM CONTAINER, OBJECT Get pointer, EXECUTE METHOD IN SUBFORM, dynamic variables) are classic-language 4D form commands that remain fully supported and are still the standard way to build reusable subforms in binary Design Mode or Project Mode databases today; the pointer-based, event-driven communication pattern between host and subform has not been replaced by any newer mechanism. However, the note's context — forms and components stored in binary .4DB/.4DC Design Mode structures — reflects the pre-Project-Mode era, and building similarly reusable UI today would more likely leverage Project Mode's text-based form files and, for simpler encapsulated pieces of logic, 4D classes rather than pointer-passing between object methods.
related_updates: Project mode with text-based .4DProject structure and form files (4D v17+, 2018) changes how components and shared forms are stored/versioned
4D classes (introduced 4D v18/v19, 2019-2020) offer an alternative to pointer-based inter-form communication for encapsulating shared logic
